fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready
fieldValues.purpose: A third party who reads the SRS spec gets a tool that behaves as written. The group closes recorded gaps between rulings, schema and the reference implementation.
fieldValues.inside: srs-rust and srs-vscode, srs docs and mirrors, and non-UI srs-web changes that execute an existing ruling.
fieldValues.authority_basis: The owner's delegation, once ratified (semanticops.com#31). It inherits the SRS implementation compass, and through it the SRS standard.
fieldValues.revision_condition: No open divergence in the divergence diff for two cycles, or the owner changes the mandate.
